page.layout: Running head at top: page number 496 at left, title CONCIONES centred. One column of running text, italic. Cropped fragments of marginal notes at the right edge. A catchword at the lower right.

p.i: rum telis interfecto, in matrimonium duxisti. Itaque à domo tua nunquam abfuturum est bellum: quoniam tu con-tempto me[illegible, ~3 letters], Vriae Hettaei uxorem tibi matrimonio copulasti. Scito, me tibi(in-quit Iova) conflaturum esse malum do-mesticum, tuasq; coniuges in oculis tuis alteri traditurum, qui cum eis in hujus congrediatur conspectu solis. Tu quidem occulte fecisti: sed ego hoc coram omnibus Israelitis luce palam facturus sum.

Tum David: Peccavi in Iovam, inquit. Et Nathan: Iova quoque remittit ille[illegible, ~3 letters] quidem tibi peccatum, neque morieris. Veruntamen, quoniam tu ista re Iovae i-nimicis maledicendi occasionem dedisti, filius, qui tibi natus est, morietur. 2. Re-gum 12.

Sed amavit Solomo rex multas prae-ter Pharaonis filiam mulieres alienige-nas, Moabitidas, Ammonitidas, Idumae-as, Sidonias, Hettaas: de quibus nationi-bus Iova Israelitis interdixerat, ne vel i-psi ad illas, vel illæ ad ipsos venirent: a.

page.notes: The right margin is cropped at the page edge. Only fragments of marginal notes remain, too short to read, so they are marked illegible at their approximate places. The "LXXVII." line is a bare number and is therefore a paragraph, not a heading. The catchword "lioquin" is partly cut off at the edge; it is probably "alioquin" and is marked as read. A small curved mark stands in the left margin beside the first lines and is not text. The "me⌣" and "ille⌣" marks in the text are curved abbreviation signs, copied as they look, not expanded.
